description: Baseline context bundle for the ReformAI persona landing-pages workspace. v1 covers the canonical product/domain/risk docs that drive persona copy and page builds. The authoritative source of these docs is the reformAI-home repo (docs/); this folder is a synced mirror for oversight agents.

docs.description: What the landing pages are, who they serve, what they do NOT do (no funnel), key brand/stack/wow decisions.
Persona definitions, design terms (bento, signature moment, AEO), source-of-truth tiers, and brand business rules.
Risks to avoid during build: WebGL perf, scope creep into the funnel, brand drift, i18n gaps, copy plausibility trap.

notes: Authoritative source: reformAI-home/docs/{PRODUCT,DOMAIN,KNOWN-RISKS}.md. Re-copy here whenever the source changes (see reformAI-home/docs/DOC-REGISTRY.md). v1 is copy-context only; the landing pages have no agent runtime yet.
